findings.claim: Prior minor #2 survives verbatim: q:2's key still shifts the statutory deadline by one day relative to the passage, and the q:2 rationale still quotes the passage wording instead of the option's - even though the repair pass edited that very rationale.

findings.claim: NEW, introduced by the repair: q:3's rationale refutes option C by appealing to the 15 September frist, but C no longer mentions the frist - it says 'sa snart arets flottning var avslutad', and the passage never equates the end of the year's flottning with the frist. The stated refutation rests on an unstated equivalence.
findings.evidence: q:3 option C: 'Rensningsarbetet upphorde helt sa snart arets flottning var avslutad.' q:3 rationale: 'C ar overgeneralisation: arets flottning gors till ett slutdatum for allt arbete, men texten sager att utryckningarna aterkom varje host just efter den femtonde september, och 1941 lag timret kvar en manad efter fristen och kravde sex dagars arbete av ett lag om fem man.' The passage dates the start of driving ('kastades i ... under varfloden') but never states when a year's flottning ends; the frist is a statutory removal deadline, not a season end. The pre-repair C did name the frist, which is what made this exact sentence work.
findings.why: The key is not at risk - C remains unsupported by the text and both post-repair G-KEY votes pick A - but the rationale is the teaching payload, and as written it asks the student to accept frist = end of season. Tighter refutation available from the text itself: efterrensning and the autumn utryckningar demonstrably continue into late autumn ('det timmer som bargades sent pa hosten').

findings.claim: Pre-existing polysemy the repair did not disturb: the passage uses 'rensa/rensning' in two distinct senses within one sentence, and q:3 C now leans on the ambiguous one.
findings.evidence: 'Pa de tre nedersta lederna, som under tjugotalet rensades pa block och tvara krokar, steg antalet rensningsdagar per flottad kubikmeter' - 'rensades' = channel clearing of boulders, 'rensningsdagar' = efterrensning of stranded timber. q:3's stem scopes to 'efterrensningen' but option C says 'Rensningsarbetet', which reads either way. The glossary defines efterrensning but not rensning.
findings.why: The stem disambiguates in practice and q:1's options depend on the same double use without confusing either G-KEY vote, so this is cosmetic. Worth a glossary line or a term split in a future revision.
